{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The anti-Iraq coalition assembled to oppose Saddam Hussein has disintegrated.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The administration pretended to support the removal of Saddam Hussein from power.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The administration did nothing when Saddam Hussein's army smashed the democratic opposition in northern Iraq in August 1996.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The administration surrendered the diplomatic initiative to Iraq and Iraq's friends.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The administration failed to champion the international inspectors charged with erasing Iraq's nuclear, biological, chemical, and ballistic missile programs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In late 1998, the administration decided to take military action, but did too little, too late.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Because of the administration's failures, there is no coalition.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Because of the administration's failures, there is no peace.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Because of the administration's failures, there is no effective inspection regime to prevent Saddam's development of weapons of mass destruction.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
